description: One asset's perpetual futures across OKX, Hyperliquid, dYdX and Kraken Futures: mark and index/oracle price, basis (mark vs index, in bps), 24h volume and open interest in USD, and funding — each venue's current or predicted rate with its funding interval, its 8-hour equivalent and simple annualized percentage. Summary: total open interest and volume, highest/lowest and open-interest-weighted 8h funding, and mark-price dispersion across venues. Accepts BTC, BTCUSDT, BTC/USDT or XBT. Venues that fail are listed under errors; the call fails (and is not charged) only if none answers. Costs $0.005 USDC per call.
